name: Backstage

install_scope.notes: Backstage only respects organization-wide installs, and only one Backstage app per organization.

manual_steps: Generate a private key and store the app ID, client ID, client secret, webhook secret and key in a YAML file included from app-config.yaml; never commit it.
Install the app on the organization. Only an organization owner can do this.
notes: Backstage doesn't use the webhook. Its CLI (create-github-app) only works on github.com; on GitHub Enterprise Server create the app manually. Pick the variant for the features you use: the docs list extra permissions for publishing software templates.

variants.name: Software catalog
variants.description: Reading software components and organization data.

variants.name: Catalog and software templates
variants.description: Also publishing software templates: creating repositories, pull requests and issues.

variants.name: Templates with workflows, variables, secrets and environments
variants.description: Only if your templates create GitHub workflows, Actions variables, Actions secrets or environments.
